meeting_locations.name: Neretva Rafting Base Konjic (Baza Džajića Buk)
meeting_locations.address: Džajići bb, 88400 Konjic, Bosna i Hercegovina
meeting_locations.instructions_bs: Doček na našoj bazi pored Neretve 45 minuta prije polaska. Obezbijeđen besplatan siguran parking, svlačionice, tuševi i toaleti.
meeting_locations.instructions_en: Welcome at our rafting base by the Neretva River 45 minutes prior to departure. Free secure parking, dressing rooms, showers, and restrooms provided.

meeting_locations.name: Stari Most Konjic - Meeting Point
meeting_locations.instructions_bs: Mjesto sastanka kod Starog mosta za goste sa organizovanim transferom.
meeting_locations.instructions_en: Meeting point at Old Stone Bridge for guests requesting shuttle pickup.

packages.short_description_bs: Najpopularnija avantura kroz netaknutu prirodu i veličanstveni kanjon Neretve. 23 km spusta.
packages.short_description_en: The signature rafting adventure through the pristine Rakitnica confluence and Neretva canyon. 23 km descent.
packages.description_bs: Iskusite nezaboravno rafting putovanje od Glavatičeva do Konjica u dužini od 23 km. Prolazite kroz impresivne kanjone, ušće rijeke Rakitnice, brzake III-IV kategorije, sa pauzama za kupanje pod vodopadima i tradicionalni BBQ roštilj na obali.
packages.description_en: Experience an unforgettable 23-kilometer rafting journey from Glavatičevo to Konjic. Navigate through breath-taking canyons, the Rakitnica river mouth, Class III-IV rapids, with swim stops under mountain waterfalls and a riverside barbecue.
included_items_json: Kompletna profesionalna oprema (neoprensko odijelo, čizmice, kaciga, prsluk)
Transfer od baze u Konjicu do startne tačke u Glavatičevu
Domaći doručak prije polaska i bogat ručak na Neretvi / bazi
GoPro fotografije i video zapisi (digitalno dostupno)
Besplatan parking i toaleti na bazi

packages.short_description_bs: Za ljubitelje većeg uzbuđenja – dinamični brzaci, skokovi sa stijena i prolaz kroz kanjon.
packages.short_description_en: For thrill-seekers – higher volume rapids, cliff jumping spots, and canyon exploration.
packages.description_bs: Specijalno prilagođena tura sa dodatnim zaustavljanjima na skakaonicama, istraživanjem pećina i prolaskom najuzbudljivijih brzaka sa profesionalnim skiperima.
packages.description_en: Specially designed adventure tour with cliff jumps, cave explorations, and tackling the most exciting rapids with certified white-water rescue guides.
included_items_json: Vrhunska IRF spasilačka oprema i neopren 5mm
Skiper instruktor sa licencom divljih voda
Skokovi sa stijena uz nadzor vodiča
Tradicionalni hercegovački ručak i piće dobrodošlice

packages.short_description_bs: Prilagođeno porodicama sa manjom decom, početnicima i timovima koji žele opušteno uživanje.
packages.short_description_en: Tailored for families with young children, beginners, and corporate teams seeking relaxing nature immersion.
packages.description_bs: Umirujuća dionica sa pitomijim vodama, prelijepim pješčanim plažama za kupanje, posmatranjem ptica i opuštajućim veslanjem.
packages.description_en: Gentle river section featuring calmer waters, sandy swim beaches, pristine bird watching, and relaxed paddling through scenic valley.
included_items_json: Sigurnosni prsluci prilagođeni djeci i odraslima
Pauze za kupanje na pješčanim plažama

addons.name_bs: Tradicionalni Neretva BBQ Ručak na obali
addons.description_bs: Domaće meso sa roštilja (ćevapi, sudžukice, piletina), hercegovački sir, sezonska salata, somun i kolač.
addons.description_en: Grilled specialties (cevapi, sausages, chicken), Herzegovina cheese, seasonal salad, freshly baked somun bread & dessert.

addons.description_bs: Grilovano povrće, veganski specijaliteti, sir iz ulja, svježe salate i voće.
addons.description_en: Grilled vegetables, vegan delicacies, traditional cheeses, fresh farm salads, and seasonal fruits.

addons.description_bs: Kompletna digitalna foto i 4K video galerija vašeg čamca dostavljena na cloud link isti dan.
addons.description_en: Complete digital photo & 4K video reel of your boat delivered via private cloud download link same day.

addons.description_bs: Klimatizirani kombi prevoz od vašeg hotela ili aerodroma u Sarajevu do naše baze u Konjicu i nazad.
addons.description_en: Air-conditioned shuttle transfer from your hotel or airport in Sarajevo to our Konjic base and return.

addons.description_bs: Klimatizirani kombi prevoz iz Mostara do baze u Konjicu i nazad.
addons.description_en: Air-conditioned shuttle transfer from Mostar to Konjic base and return.

faqs.question_bs: Trebam li imati prethodno iskustvo u raftingu?
faqs.answer_bs: Ne, prethodno iskustvo nije potrebno! Naš tim čine licencirani i iskusni skiperi koji će prije samog spusta održati detaljan sigurnosni brifing i voditi vas kroz svaki dio rijeke.
faqs.question_en: Do I need previous white-water rafting experience?
faqs.answer_en: No prior experience is necessary! Our certified IRF river guides deliver an extensive safety briefing before launch and navigate you safely through every rapid and canyon stretch.

faqs.question_bs: Koja oprema je obezbijeđena za učesnike?
faqs.answer_bs: Obezbjeđujemo vrhunsku profesionalnu opremu prema EU i IRF standardima: neoprenska odijela i čizmice (prilagođene vašoj veličini), sigurnosni prsluk visoke plovnosti, kacigu i veslo.
faqs.question_en: What safety equipment is provided for guests?
faqs.answer_en: We provide full professional CE and IRF certified gear: tailored neoprene wetsuits and thermal booties, high-buoyancy life jackets, helmets, and paddles.

faqs.question_bs: Kada i kako se vrši plaćanje?
faqs.answer_bs: Plaćanje se vrši direktno na našoj bazi u Konjicu prije polaska na turu. Prihvatamo gotovinu (BAM ili EUR) i platne kartice na POS terminalu. Nije potrebno online plaćanje unaprijed.
faqs.question_en: When and how do we pay for our rafting trip?
faqs.answer_en: Payment takes place on-site at our Konjic base before trip departure. We accept cash (BAM or EUR) and credit/debit cards on our mobile POS terminal. No advance online card deposit required.

faqs.question_bs: Mogu li djeca učestvovati na raftingu?
faqs.answer_bs: Da, djeca od 6 i više godina mogu bezbjedno učestvovati na klasičnoj turi uz prisustvo roditelja ili staratelja. Za mlađe mališane imamo posebne prilagođene porodične dionice sa manjim brzacima.
faqs.question_en: Can children participate in rafting trips?
faqs.answer_en: Yes! Children aged 6 and above can safely join our Classic tour accompanied by parents. For younger toddlers, we offer specialized calm family sections with gentle waters and swim stops.

faqs.question_bs: Šta ponijeti sa sobom na bazu?
faqs.answer_bs: Ponesite kupaći kostim / šorc, suhi peškir, suhu presvlaku za poslije raftinga i kremu za sunčanje. Sve lične stvari, novčanike i telefone možete bezbjedno ostaviti u našim zaključanim ormarićima na bazi.
faqs.question_en: What personal items should we bring?
faqs.answer_en: Bring your swimwear, a dry towel, a change of clothes for after the trip, and sunscreen. You can store all dry clothing, phones, and valuables in our locked base lockers.

org-konjic-rafting-01.hero_title_bs: Doživite Smaragdnu Neretvu u Srcu Konjica
org-konjic-rafting-01.hero_title_en: Experience the Emerald Neretva in Konjic
org-konjic-rafting-01.hero_subtitle_bs: Najbolje ocijenjeno rafting iskustvo u Bosni i Hercegovini. 23 km adrenalina, netaknuti kanjon i vrhunski licencirani skiperi.
org-konjic-rafting-01.hero_subtitle_en: Top-rated white water rafting experience in Bosnia & Herzegovina. 23 km of pristine canyon adventure and certified IRF river guides.
org-konjic-rafting-01.about_text_bs: Već više od 18 godina vodimo domaće i inostrane avanturiste kroz kanjon rijeke Neretve. Naša baza u Džajićima nudi kompletnu logističku podršku, besplatan parking, moderne svlačionice, vrhunsku opremu i autentičnu hercegovačku kuhinju.
org-konjic-rafting-01.about_text_en: For over 18 years we have guided adventurers from across the globe through the majestic Neretva canyon. Our river base in Džajići provides comprehensive amenities, free parking, modern dressing facilities, premium gear, and authentic culinary hospitality.
org-konjic-rafting-01.safety_intro_bs: Sigurnost gostiju je naš apsolutni prioritet. Svi naši skiperi posjeduju međunarodne IRF licence i certifikate spašavanja na divljim vodama. Svaki učesnik zadužuje homologovanu zaštitnu opremu i osiguran je tokom čitave ture.
org-konjic-rafting-01.safety_intro_en: Your safety is our highest mission. All guides hold International Rafting Federation (IRF) certifications and Swiftwater Rescue credentials. Every guest is outfitted with premium tested gear and covered by comprehensive insurance.
org-konjic-rafting-01.address: Džajići bb, 88400 Konjic, Bosna i Hercegovina
org-konjic-rafting-01.meeting_point_instructions_bs: Dolazak na našu bazu u Džajićima 45 minuta prije izabranog polaska.
org-konjic-rafting-01.meeting_point_instructions_en: Please arrive at our Džajići base 45 minutes prior to your scheduled departure.
